title: Subject matter
how_addressed: Defines what DORA regulates. Framing in docs/00-scope.md.

title: Scope

how_addressed: Terms used consistently in docs; glossary planned in the docs site (PR #3).

title: Proportionality principle
how_addressed: Proportionality reasoning for a small payment institution written down; not quantified.

title: Governance and organisation

title: Management body responsibilities (strategy, roles, budget, policies)
how_addressed: No management body exists in a lab; governance templates planned.

title: ICT risk management framework
how_addressed: The platform, its docs and its generated evidence form the technical half of a framework; risk register and strategy missing.

title: Sound, comprehensive and well-documented framework
how_addressed: Control matrix, shared-responsibility model, exceptions register, runbooks.

title: Independent ICT risk control function
how_addressed: Single builder; independence cannot be demonstrated.

title: Framework reviewed at least yearly and after major incidents
how_addressed: No review cycle; ISMS calendar planned.

title: Digital operational resilience strategy
how_addressed: Strategy template planned.

title: ICT systems, protocols and tools
how_addressed: Immutable, API-driven OS (Talos); everything pinned and GitOps-reconciled. No capacity/performance metrics yet.

title: Identification
how_addressed: Generated inventory of every chart and image; heuristic critical-asset labels; no yearly review.

title: Identify and map critical assets
how_addressed: CRITICAL_FUNCTIONS in the RoI generator labels Keycloak, Kyverno, MinIO, Velero as critical.

title: Protection and prevention
how_addressed: Admission control, default-deny networking, internal PKI, SSO with RBAC, signed images, encryption at rest.

title: Continuously monitor and control security and functioning
how_addressed: Loki/Grafana/Hubble observe; Kyverno enforces Pod Security Standards restricted.

title: Integrity and confidentiality of data at rest, in use and in transit
how_addressed: cert-manager TLS; Talos Secrets encryption at rest by default; hash chains for integrity. Negotiated TLS not yet evidenced.

title: Automated isolation; networks can be severed or segmented
how_addressed: Cilium default-deny in every platform namespace; network-partition drill proves deny and recovery. Isolation is policy-driven, not attack-triggered.

title: Access limited to legitimate and approved functions
how_addressed: Keycloak groups mapped to Argo CD and Grafana roles; restricted pods.

title: Strong authentication and cryptographic key protection
how_addressed: OIDC SSO. No MFA yet. Key handling moves to per-stand-up generated PKI (T02).

title: Change management: recorded, tested, assessed, approved, implemented, verified
how_addressed: GitOps via Argo CD; CI tests (PR #2). No required-review branch protection.

title: Documented patch and update policies
how_addressed: Pinned versions; weekly image rebuild; Trivy ages findings. No written patch policy.

title: Detection
how_addressed: Two real alert rules over two layers (API audit log, Tetragon eBPF); measured detection latency. No paging.

title: Promptly detect anomalous activities; mechanisms regularly tested
how_addressed: Detection exercised by drills; t_detect read from Grafana's alert API. Single runs so far.

title: Multiple layers of control, thresholds, automatic alerts to staff
how_addressed: Two layers and explicit thresholds implemented; automatic alerting of staff not built.

title: Response and recovery
how_addressed: Five measured drills with runbooks; no BCP, BIA or audit of plans.

title: ICT business continuity policy
how_addressed: Template planned.

title: Respond, recover, estimate impact
how_addressed: ns-restore, node-kill and pvc-corruption-restore drills; classification estimates impact from measured RTO/RPO plus synthetic profile.

title: Business impact analysis
how_addressed: BIA planned with the risk register.

title: Test BCP and response/recovery plans at least yearly
how_addressed: Drills are repeatable but not scheduled.

title: Backup policies, restoration and recovery
how_addressed: Velero + MinIO, measured RTO and exact RPO, hash-chain integrity check. Same-cluster restore; verdict ignores targets.

title: Backup scope and minimum frequency by criticality
how_addressed: Hourly Velero Schedule; 3-hour retention is a lab constraint.

title: Test backup and restore periodically
how_addressed: ns-restore and pvc-corruption-restore drills; not scheduled.

title: Restore onto physically and logically segregated systems
how_addressed: Restores go to a fresh namespace on the same cluster.

title: Redundant ICT capacities
how_addressed: One control-plane node.

title: RTO and RPO set per function
how_addressed: Targets recorded in each drill record; verdict does not yet compare against them.

title: Learning and evolving
how_addressed: Threat/vulnerability intake via Trivy + CISA KEV; post-incident review section on every ticket (boilerplate).

title: Communication
how_addressed: No crisis communication plan.

title: Further harmonisation of ICT risk management tools, methods, processes and policies
how_addressed: Mandate for the RTS on the ICT risk management framework (see the Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1774 row).

title: Simplified ICT risk management framework
how_addressed: The notional tenant is modelled as a fully authorised payment institution, not eligible for the simplified framework.
